title: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback: Whose Culture, Whose Values, Whose Perspectives?

bias_targets.methodology: Philosophical and conceptual analysis of the RLHF pipeline, applying social epistemology to evaluate how homogeneous labeler demographics (e.g., WEIRD populations) exclude marginalized socio-cultural perspectives and lead to biased model alignment.

Conceptual evaluation and literature review analyzing how human feedback collection and reward model aggregation in RLHF can amplify specific political ideologies, sycophancy, and politically unbalanced judgments.

Application of pluralist philosophy of science to assess how a lack of cognitive diversity and value triangulation among RLHF evaluators limits the objectivity, accuracy, and ethical robustness of LLM outputs.
